LESSON: READING 12.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: COMPREHENSION STRATEGIES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why are contextual clues important to infer information and meanings of words in a text? 2. How do we get information from a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify mental images in a text correctly,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use contextual clues to infer information and meanings of words correctly in a text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. acknowledge the role of comprehension in effective communication. ● In groups, guide learners to read the passage on modern fashion and highlight sentences that create mental images. ● Guide learners to read the passage on modern fashion in turns as they answer direct and inferential questions. ● Guide learners to infer the meaning of words and expressions using contextual clues. ● In pairs, guide the learners to present mental pictures from the text on charts for learners with low vision or in a written prose for learners with blindness and display them. 1. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking: The learner identifies sentences that create mental images, and infers meanings of words and expressions

using contextual clues.

● Communication and collaboration: The learner works in pairs or groups to accomplish the task of presenting mental pictures

from the text on charts or in a written prose and displaying them.
